title: Reformat Date
summary: Convert a date string from 'Day Month Year' format to 'YYYY-MM-DD' format, ensuring the year is between 1900 and 2100, and the day and month are appropriately formatted.
statement: Convert a date string from 'Day Month Year' format to 'YYYY-MM-DD' format, ensuring the year is between 1900 and 2100, and the day and month are appropriately formatted.
constraints: Input is day-with-suffix, three-letter month, and four-digit year.
Return the zero-padded ISO form YYYY-MM-DD.
hints: Remove the final two ordinal-suffix characters from the day.
Map the month abbreviation to a number from one through twelve.
Format year, month, and day with two-digit padding.
editorial: Format year, month, and day with two-digit padding.

tests.explanation: October is month ten and the ordinal suffix is removed, producing 2052-10-20.
Both month and day are padded to two digits, producing 1933-06-06.
